messages:
kai (DevEx): Quick report from new hire pairing: the quickstart README has several out-of-date code blocks (JS + Python) that break the sample app. raising so docs/sdk team can triage.
ara (SDK): thanks — did you capture the failing snippet?
kai (DevEx): yep. README shows this JS block:
```js
const Redwood = require('redwood-js-sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const out = await client.generate('Hello');
console.log(out.text);
```
kai (DevEx): runtime: TypeError: client.generate is not a function. Also the quickstart env list doesn't mention RW_API_KEY (we standardized on that).
jo (docs): hmm we must have missed a cross-repo rename when v0.9 landed. The package name and surface changed; examples should use @redwood/inference-js and client.chat.create.
ara (SDK): yes, v0.9 split chat/completions. defaults also changed: retry default is 0 now (docs still mention 3). that explains some support tickets where simple quickstarts hit 429s.
kai (DevEx): I also noticed the README uses REDACTED_API_KEY in a few places. we've had two accidental deployments where people left the placeholder. can we add a guard?
jo (docs): plan: I'll open a docs PR that updates all language quickstarts, adds a short migration note at the top, and replaces placeholders with an explicit export example: export RW_API_KEY=your_real_key plus a security blurb.
ara (SDK): i'll add a small runtime check in SDKs to detect legacy env names (REDWOOD_KEY, OLD_API_KEY) and throw a clear error suggesting RW_API_KEY. also propose emitting a deprecation warning for one minor before removing.
kai (DevEx): can we also put the example code behind a runnable smoke test in CI so we catch these earlier?
jo (docs): good idea — examples-smoke in GH actions already exists but it only runs node. i'll expand it to python and add a step that fails if any code block contains /(REDACTED|PLACEHOLDER|YOUR_KEY)/i.
examples-bot: PR opened by jo: "docs: update quickstart examples, add migration note, CI example checks" https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/899
ci-bot: running examples-smoke workflow for docs/fix-quickstart (runners: node, python)
ci-bot: examples-smoke failed (run 77): detected placeholder "REDACTED_API_KEY" in README -> blocking merge (good catch).
jo (docs): replaced placeholders with explicit RW_API_KEY instructions and added before/after snippets for JS+Python. pushed fix.
ci-bot: examples-smoke passed (run 78). node and python quickstarts executed against staging fixture.
ara (SDK): merged SDK guard and added a small note in changelog about the auth var rename and retry default change. i'll prepare a tiny patch to print a helpful message if old env var names are present.
kai (DevEx): awesome. will update the onboarding checklist to include "run examples-smoke locally" so new hires validate the quickstart. tiny copy/paste drift like this ruins first-run DX. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
jo (docs): PR merged and backported to release/v0.9.x. closing thread.
